svg.title: Setting up the search
svg.desc: Install the app. In Paperless-ngx, create an account that may read the documents and an API token for it. In the administration settings of Nextcloud, enter the URL, the token and the archive account, select Paperless runs in my local network when Nextcloud reaches Paperless at such an address, and select Test connection and save. When Paperless answers, the settings are saved; otherwise nothing is saved and the message says what to correct. The archive account shares its archive read-only with the users who may find its documents, and they find them under Paperless documents in Nextcloud's search, with Search connected services switched on.
